name: forge-master-simulator
description: Forge Master V2 simulator with web, API, Postgres and a pure simulation engine

scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w packages/game-data && npm run build -w packages/simulator && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w packages/game-data && npm run build -w packages/simulator && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/game-data && npm run build -w packages/simulator && npm run build -w apps/api && node scripts/generate-simulated-bis.mjs && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.bis:generate: npm run build -w packages/game-data && npm run build -w packages/simulator && node scripts/generate-simulated-bis.mjs
